title: [Optimizer Demo] Miku — Boost trade-off baseline
description: Remix this template into an unsaved draft. Lock Hatsune Miku and choose BOOST, then Balanced. Priorities: Boost > Speed > Acceleration > Handling; maximum losses: 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%. Move Power to tie-break only. Calculate and compare the allowed Boost sacrifice with the other gains, then Apply to your draft. The template remains unchanged. Uses reviewed Ver. 1.4.1 passive arithmetic; race-time effects are outside the objective.
